name: AHDQuestionnaireResponseComplete
title: PET confirmation ($complete)
description: UC-AHD-055: confirms a patient's end-of-life directive (PET). Input is exactly one of: a digitally signed PET as a Binary (signedBinary) or a QuestionnaireResponse and Provenance collection Bundle for paper signing (bundle). Under the stage-1 mock configuration, the digital path parses the ASiC-E container without DigiDoc signature verification and stores it locally instead of DRIT. Where digital signing is not enabled, the digital path responds with HTTP 501.

parameter.name: signedBinary
parameter.documentation: Digitally signed PET (ASiC-E container) as a Binary resource.

parameter.name: bundle
parameter.documentation: Collection Bundle with the QuestionnaireResponse and the paper-signing Provenance.

parameter.name: questionnaireResponse
parameter.documentation: Reference to the stored PET version.

parameter.name: provenance
parameter.documentation: Reference to the stored signing Provenance.

parameter.name: signedBinary
parameter.documentation: Reference to the stored signed Binary (digital signing only).
